title: ZTD lifecycle Builder Node
description: Input and output contract of the ztd-lifecycle node, which deploys and uninstalls one Helm release in a provisioned namespace. The message shapes follow the tender's work-sample contract: a command in, an explicit result out.

release.description: Helm release name: a DNS-1123 label of at most 53 characters.

namespace.description: An existing, provisioned namespace. The node never creates namespaces.

chart.description: Required for deploy: a chart path inside the ORCE image, or an oci:// reference pinned by digest.

values.description: Required for deploy: the release values. The chart's own schema validates them; they are never logged.

data.description: On acknowledgement {accepted: true}; on a final deploy result the release, namespace, clusterId, revision, chartDigest, valuesHash, helmVersion and the expected object list.

errors.description: null on success. errors.fields names each invalid parameter; errors.action carries a reason code for a refused or failed action.
